Rockwell Automation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and trades under the ticker ROK. Its website is at rockwellautomation.com. The only text harvested from that site is a region selector, so the company's own pages offer no description here of what it makes or sells.

No products are tracked for the company and no MCP servers are listed. No lawsuits are listed either, though its litigation exposure is recorded in Wisconsin, with a count of 62. The company's SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001024478.
